name: Record Book Rewritten: The Milestones of 2026
angle: World Cup 2026 was a records tournament beyond Messi: Mbappe became France's all-time scorer on his 100th cap, 41-year-old Ronaldo became the oldest outfield player to start a World Cup match and the first to score at six tournaments, Kane drew level with Lineker, and Tielemans scored the latest goal in World Cup history. Curated and de-duplicated from the daily World Cup quiz series.

questions.question: Kylian Mbappe became which nation's all-time leading scorer during their opening 3-1 win over Senegal?
Mbappe's brace against Senegal saw him overtake which striker as France's all-time leading scorer?
Mbappe drew level with Klose on 16 World Cup goals with a brace against Iraq, on what landmark occasion for the France captain?
Cristiano Ronaldo's brace against Uzbekistan made him the first player ever to score at how many different World Cups?
Messi and Ronaldo shared a new distinction in 2026, becoming the first players ever to do what?

options.A: Appear at six different World Cups
options.B: Score at six different World Cups
options.C: Captain a side at six World Cups

questions.question: By starting against DR Congo at 41 years old, Ronaldo set which World Cup record?

options.A: Oldest outfield player to start a World Cup match
options.B: Oldest goalscorer in World Cup history
options.C: Oldest captain at a World Cup
options.D: Oldest player ever to appear at a World Cup

questions.question: Ronaldo, scoring at 41, became the second-oldest goalscorer in World Cup history. Who remains the oldest, having struck for Cameroon at USA 94?
Harry Kane's opener against Croatia was his 10th World Cup goal, drawing him level with England's tournament record holder. Who is that?
Youri Tielemans' penalty against Senegal, timed at 124 minutes and 44 seconds, set what World Cup record?

options.A: The latest goal ever scored in a World Cup match
options.B: The fastest penalty in a World Cup match
options.C: The first successful extra-time penalty in a shootout
options.D: The latest red card in a World Cup match

questions.question: Canada's 6-0 win over Qatar was the biggest in men's World Cup history by a team from which confederation?
Curacao are the smallest nation by population ever to reach a men's World Cup. Whose record did they take?
Mbappe broke Just Fontaine's France record of 13 goals at a single World Cup, a tally Fontaine set in which year?
Vozinha's clean sheet for Cabo Verde made him the third-oldest goalkeeper to keep one in a men's World Cup match. He trails only which two greats?
Jude Bellingham's strike against Croatia made him only the third man to score at two different World Cups before turning 23. Which two legends were already in that group?
Vinicius Junior became only the fifth Brazilian to score in all three group matches at a World Cup. Which forward set the benchmark by scoring in every match of Brazil's victorious 1970 campaign?
